query: UPDATE eval_executions x SET status=$5,result=$6,finished_at=NOW(),lease_expires_at=NULL FROM eval_experiments e WHERE x.experiment_id=e.id AND e.owner_id=$1 AND e.status='running' AND x.id=$2 AND x.lease_owner=$3 AND x.fencing_token=$4 AND x.lease_expires_at>NOW() AND x.deadline_at>NOW() AND x.status='running' RETURNING x.experiment_id
